## Key ideas {#fgt1-finish .trig-lesson}

| Feature | Sine and cosine | Tangent |
|---|---|---|
| Amplitude | $|a|$ | No amplitude |
| Period | $\dfrac{2\pi}{|n|}$ | $\dfrac{\pi}{|n|}$ |
| Construction | Midline, extrema, quarter-period points | Asymptotes, centres, guide points |

For a horizontal shift: **factor first, sketch the unshifted graph, then translate**.

::: {.takeaway .fragment}
I can sketch a modified trigonometric graph with its key features correctly labelled.
:::

::: notes

The parameter forms are y=a sin(n(x−c))+b, y=a cos(n(x−c))+b and y=a tan(n(x−c))+b, a,n nonzero. Use this as a brief check, not another lecture. Ask a student to explain why a horizontal shift leaves amplitude and period unchanged. If time permits, use booklet Example 1.10 orally as a further check: y=4 sin 2πx−1 has amplitude 4, period 1, midline −1 and quarter-period 1/4. Do not relabel this as a new compulsory example.

:::
